product_updates.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
product_updates.content: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.

product_updates.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
product_updates.content: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.

product_updates.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
product_updates.content: Microsoft bolstered its AI cybersecurity offerings this week with the launch of its first AI security model and a new security platform.

product_updates.title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
product_updates.content: OpenAI's Hugging Face breach has reignited debate over AI alignment and control, exposing competing views on whether increasingly capable AI should be better aligned, better contained, or both.

product_updates.title: Threads users can now chat with Meta AI in their DMs
product_updates.content: Meta on Monday said it is rolling out its Meta AI chatbot within Threads' DMs, giving users a way to chat with the AI assistant.

product_updates.title: Google’s AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
product_updates.content: Google’s AI Overviews now appear in 43% of searches, underscoring how quickly AI-generated answers are becoming the default way people discover information online.

product_updates.title: Power up your AI infrastructure! A first look at the Smart Systems Stage agenda at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
product_updates.content: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the Smart Systems Stage will be where energy, infrastructure, and technology collide, covering everything from fusion breakthroughs to the grid strain AI is putting on the entire economy.

product_updates.title: This $9 key physically locks your most addictive apps
product_updates.content: This $9 NFC key requires you to physically scan it to unlock distracting apps on your phone.

product_updates.title: Ilya Sutskever’s Safe Superintelligence partners with Nvidia to scale its AI research
product_updates.content: After two years in stealth, Safe Superintelligence has announced a long-term partnership with Nvidia as it prepares to scale to its next phase.

product_updates.title: Enigma raises $71M to make controlling a robot as easy as adjusting the volume
product_updates.content: The massive seed round was led by Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, with participation from Sarah Guo's Conviction Partners.
